name: rpg-shared
description: Plain TypeScript source, not published or built on its own — consumed by sibling apps under tools/ via a bundler alias (see each app's vite.config.ts / tsconfig.app.json for "@shared/*"). This package.json exists only so react's types and JSX runtime resolve for files under src/ that use them (e.g. components/LevelPicker.tsx); it has no scripts of its own.
